text:
I recently had a root canal treatment at Doctor Smile Dental Clinic, and I couldn't be more satisfied with the experience. From the moment I walked in, the staff was incredibly welcoming and made me feel at ease immediately. The clinic is spotless and equipped with the latest dental technology, which reassured me that I was in good hands.

The dentist who performed my root canal was exceptionally skilled and caring. They explained each step of the procedure clearly, ensuring I was comfortable and understood what to expect. The treatment was virtually painless, and I was impressed by the meticulous attention to detail.

The aftercare provided by Doctor Smile Dental Clinic was outstanding. I received thorough instructions on how to care for my tooth post-treatment, and the follow-up calls to check on my recovery showed their genuine concern for my well-being.

Overall, I highly recommend Doctor Smile Dental Clinic for anyone in need of dental care. Their commitment to patient comfort and quality treatment truly sets them apart. Thank you, Doctor Smile Dental Clinic, for making what could have been a stressful experience completely stress-free!

text: I was not a patient of Dr. Smile - I was the friend of a patient helping him get his orthodontic treatment started.  We went in together to find out the pricing and plan as we compared with other providers in Pattaya. We chose Dr. Smile based on price and recommendations from other patients we knew.  I was disappointed after treatment started that the office staff I met with was unable to provide me a written plan, pricing, and payment schedule.  After a few attempts and some emails back and forth months after the start of treatment I am now clear.  Apparently because orthodontic treatment is almost exclusively provided to Thai patients they do not provide this information in writing as these patients prefer to receive information orally.  I was assured that for western/foreign patients they provide all this information (pricing, plan) in writing and payment is almost always done at time of service and not on a plan as treatment is not months or years long. Also, as the non patient I think that they did a good job working with me to help me understand. My friend, the patient, is pleased with the service.
